title: [Audit] Kibana saved-object activity by actor
description: Every Kibana event that named an object, newest first and capped at the newest 1,000 in range: reads and changes, with the object’s real name, type and space. Objects that carry no saved_object fields (workflows, ML jobs, agent-builder agents and tools) are recovered from the event message, so they appear here too. Kibana’s own page and API requests (http_request), logins and point-in-time internals name no object and are left out. Message is the sentence Kibana wrote for the event. An Identity that reads as an opaque id is a principal whose events carry no email and no key name — usually an organisation-level Elastic Cloud API key, which the audit stream records only by its id.
esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" | WHERE (attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL OR attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_*" OR attributes.event.action LIKE "workflow_*" OR attributes.event.action LIKE "agent_builder_*" OR attributes.event.action LIKE "product_documentation_*" OR attributes.event.action == "secret_create") | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 1000 | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | EVAL verb = CASE(attributes.event.action LIKE "*_execution_cancel", "cancel", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_run_soon", "run", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_run", "run", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_test", "test", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_enable", "enable", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_disable", "disable", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_put_*", "create", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_open_*", "open", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_start_*", "start", attributes.event.action LIKE "*point_in_time", "pit", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_create*", "create", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_update*", "update", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_delete", "delete", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_find", "find", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_get", "get", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_resolve", "resolve", "other") | GROK body.text """\[(?:id|workflowId)=%{DATA:g_id}(?:,|\])""" | GROK body.text """\[name=%{GREEDYDATA:g_name}\]""" | GROK body.text """\[executionId=%{DATA:g_exec}\]""" | GROK body.text """case id: %{NOTSPACE:g_case}""" | GROK body.text """(?:job|datafeed) %{NOTSPACE:g_ml}""" | EVAL obj_type = CASE(attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL, attributes.kibana.saved_object.type, attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_job", "ml-job", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_datafeed", "ml-datafeed", attributes.event.action LIKE "workflow_execution_*", "workflow-execution", attributes.event.action LIKE "workflow_*", "workflow", attributes.event.action LIKE "agent_builder_agent_*", "agent-builder-agent", attributes.event.action LIKE "agent_builder_tool_*", "agent-builder-tool", attributes.event.action LIKE "product_documentation_*", "product-documentation", attributes.event.action == "secret_create", "secret", attributes.event.action IS NULL, "unclassified", REPLACE(attributes.event.action, "_(create|update|delete|enable|disable|run|run_soon|test|cancel)$", "")) | EVAL obj_name = COALESCE(attributes.kibana.saved_object.name, g_name, g_id, attributes.kibana.saved_object.id, g_case, g_ml, g_exec, body.text) | KEEP @timestamp, actor, verb, obj_type, obj_name, attributes.kibana.space.id, body.text | RENAME @timestamp AS Time, actor AS Identity, verb AS Operation, obj_type AS `Object type`, obj_name AS Object, attributes.kibana.space.id AS Space, body.text AS Message
